paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles with the Perseus Galaxy Cluster with MAGIC
notes: MAGIC 41.3 hr observation of NGC 1275 in the Perseus cluster searching for ALP-induced spectral irregularities. New observed exclusion limit at 99% CL (paper quotes 99% CL; enum forced to 0.95 — actual is 0.99). No exclusion contour table is provided; data points are approximate reconstructions from text statements: strongest limit g_agamma = 3e-12 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 40-50 neV; most competitive constraints for 40-90 neV; excluded masses span ~40-400 neV; parameter scan covered 4e-9 to 1e-6 eV in mass and 5e-13 to 5e-10 GeV^-1 in coupling. This is an astrophysical photon-ALP conversion bound (not a haloscope), so no local DM density is assumed. The paper also contains a CTA-comparison projection (Fig. 4), but the primary result is the observed 99% CL limit. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
